_comments.format: Valid JSON; this _comments object documents settings and is ignored by the scanner.
_comments.paths: Use absolute host paths. The scanner needs root /proc and GPU visibility; do not run it inside a workload container.
_comments.host_passwd_path: Local regular host passwd file, read at most once per scan and at most 64 KiB within the shared byte/time budget. No NSS lookup is performed; unknown or ambiguous usernames remain null.
_comments.sample_interval_seconds: Nominal host sample interval, 30 through 300 seconds. The installer sets the timer OnUnitActiveSec to match this value.
_comments.scan_budget_seconds: Monotonic budget for discovery, commands, ownership checks, parsing and scraping. Maximum 20 seconds.
_comments.target_timeout_seconds: Each target HTTP/listener command uses the remaining scan budget and at most this value; maximum 2 seconds.
_comments.gpu_query_timeout_seconds: Each nvidia-smi inventory/compute query uses the remaining scan budget and at most this value. Default 5 seconds; accepts 0.01 through 10 seconds.
_comments.limits: Limits may be lowered. Discovery limits mark inventory incomplete; oversized snapshots retain the previous file.
_comments.max_services: Accepts 1 through 256, default 256. Exceeding the cap sets inventory_complete=false; omitted services remain unknown to the consumer.
_comments.match_rules: Each rule matches exact case-insensitive argv tokens (and command basenames), with every all token required. No shell or regular expressions are evaluated.
_comments.managed_container: A vllm-*.service process in this container is labeled managed_by=llmsvc; this label grants no control authority.
